_doc: Description tokens whose value no client table this build ships carries: the token names a spell (or an effect row) the server knows and the client export does not. Each value is what Wowhead's Forever tooltip prints for the spell, read 2026-11-10; pipeline/spelltext_gaps.py writes it into the spell's template before the renderer runs, so every surface (talents, tooltips, items, sets) reads the same words. Remove an entry when the client starts carrying the row: the loader refuses a token the template no longer holds.
